_comment: Washington 9% Policies Chapter 4 Minimum Threshold Requirements (pp.25-36). Omitted: 4.2 (correction period), 4.12 (consultant contracts), 4.18 (related-party rehabilitation, detailed) and 4.19 (disqualification). The Chapter 3 program limits (TDC limits and so on) are not itemised.

criteria.heading: Complete Application and Appropriate Fee
criteria.quote: The Applicant must submit a complete, legible, and executed Application.
